finding.mechanism: Existing candidates increment source_count before candidate_sources INSERT OR IGNORE establishes whether provenance is new. Replaying the same source execution or surfacing it through multiple chunks/extractors can therefore increase scheduling weight without new evidence.
finding.risk: Backlog ordering uses source_count as a secondary priority; inflated counts can bias the historical 39M-token re-evaluation toward repeated provenance and undermine Goodman-style evidence collapse.

delta.rule: For candidates with candidate_sources links, source_count is reconciled to COUNT(DISTINCT source_event_id) after each historical ingestion pass. Legacy candidates with no source links are left unchanged.

cases: same source execution across multiple chunks/extractors counts once
legacy candidate without source links is not silently reinterpreted

next_exact_gate: Execute the branch tests plus existing historical-backfill suite on exact branch source in clay-direct-dev, verify full historical replay does not increase source_count on a second saturation pass, then fuse only if current main has no successor implementation.
evidence_boundary: The local unit pass verifies the isolated deterministic reconciliation logic only. It is not a terminal exact-current VPS receipt, full historical-backfill execution, EntityOS/HCU runtime acceptance, J-Space model evidence, or training evidence.
